hypothesis: A large cross-sectional breadth sign reversal is a discrete market-cycle transition; institutional breadth agreement or override may improve the subsequent 20-trading-day TWII direction forecast.
target: TWII close direction from event date to 20 actual cash-market trading days later

eligibility.reason: Preserve six years of causal history before formal evaluation.

event.definition: Price advance-decline breadth changes sign and both current and prior absolute breadth are at least 0.20.
event.threshold_selection: Selected using unlabeled feasibility counts only; 0.20 was the strongest tested round threshold retaining at least 100 non-overlapping base and institution-confirmed events.

variants.price_transition: On every non-overlapping event, predict the sign of current price breadth.
variants.institutional_override: On the identical event dates, use institutional-breadth sign when its absolute value is at least 0.10; otherwise use current price-breadth sign.
variants.institutional_confirmation: Select events where institutional breadth agrees with current price breadth and has absolute value at least 0.10, apply cooldown after confirmation, and predict the agreed sign.

formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this manifest and implementation hash are locked. No result-dependent threshold, rule, date, or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: A variant is promoted only if every absolute, sample, coverage, stability and identical-date strongest-baseline gate passes. Institutional override is additionally considered incremental only when it significantly beats price transition on identical dates.
